items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Exactly. A lot of people thought Joni had done it.

ctx.x: Annie, I’ve been listening to you ever since my father first put on Sing a Song of Basie, and I went, whoa. Then when I heard Twisted, I – whoa. Then when I got a little older, then Joni Mitchell did Twisted, I went, wait a minute, I’ve already heard that.
Exactly. A lot of people thought Joni had done it.
Right. But that’s not really the case. Then she came back and did Centerpiece, and I said, I already heard that too. So Joni was mining the wellspring of . . .
